centre_load_trials.basis: Designer screening envelope, not adopted standard. Includes demand margin over LT2 2g body reactions; braking/draft/fault combinations remain to finalize.

pitch_pin.model: Conservative central point load on simply supported pin

yaw_pin.note: Distributed radial sleeve reaction/contact, root fillet and base fixation not resolved.

side_support.limits: Gap side supports, not secondary heave suspension. Rubber curve/creep, pad guidance, roll stability and friction must be accepted by supplier and dynamic analysis.

retention.basis: One catch taking2g truck deadweight only; not crash, derailment impact or locomotive lifting qualification.

frame_height.status: Selected LT3 development baseline; production freeze blocked by detailed joints, stability and full movement verification.

mass.note: Not additive to previous complete allowances: replace overlapping cab/body allowance and allocate new connection mass between body and truck. Purchased bearing mass not included in nominal envelope volume. Gross12t target is not revalidated.

limitations: No fatigue, contact, buckling, bolt preload, weld/WPS or housing retention acceptance.
Gimbal and catch concepts include incomplete load-path details explicitly listed per part; positive retention is not yet certified.
No claim that all parts fit through every combined movement. Specific checks are separate from the unresolved CAD collision report.
Primary spring and damper target values assume1:1 vertical motion and four units per truck. DT must return installed layout, motion ratios and force curves.
primary_suspension_return_status: Historical DT2 basis; DT3 supersedes mass/wheelbase. See dt3-reconciliation.json

latest_DT3_sensitivity.basis: Mass-floor sensitivity only: DT3 known truck+LT3 connection mass, DT3 wheel/axle unsprung mass. Other axle-mounted masses not split; missing parts and revised body reactions can move this result. NOT a spring selection.
